LOW POLY AIRFIELD — FREE SAMPLE
===============================
Three models from the Low Poly Airfield Pack, free to use in personal and
commercial projects.

    plane_prop   light high-wing aircraft, 8.2 m, 842 tris
    windsock     mast with striped sock, 284 tris
    cone         marker cone, 100 tris

Each in .glb, .fbx, .obj and .blend.
Flat shading, solid colour materials — no textures, no UV maps.
Z-up, metres, origin at the base, rotation and scale applied.

THE FULL PACK
-------------
16 models: five different aircraft (airliner, cargo turboprop, business jet,
light prop, biplane), hangar, control tower, fuel truck, boarding stairs,
baggage cart, light mast, fence, trees — plus a Blender add-on that
generates complete airfields from parameters, and the full demo scene.

    https://eh98.itch.io/low-poly-airfield-pack

LICENCE
-------
Use in personal and commercial projects, any number of them. Modify freely.
Do not resell or redistribute the files themselves as an asset pack.
No credit required.

— EH98
